changelog: STEPS WAS ALWAYS ZERO. The run-end screen has been reporting 0 steps every run, win or lose, since the stat existed: the distance counter only ever ran on the enemy AI's move path, never on your own, so nothing you did was counted. Two more things quietly rode on that same broken line and are now alive — the score's efficiency term (which never decayed, so it was always paying full) and the NEVER STOP MOVING medal, whose +2 defense for a unit that moved this turn had never once armed. THE ENEMY TURN NO LONGER LINGERS. Every visible enemy action cost at least half a second because the code meant to compress a busy turn was clamped dead by a stray floor. Measured across 1251 real enemy turns: one in four ran past 5 seconds, the worst past 20. The whole replay is now budgeted — a quiet turn plays exactly as before, a crowded one no longer punishes you — and you can TAP TO SKIP the rest of it. Taps are left alone while an enemy card reveal or a boss line is up, so those still wait for you. END TURN CAN NO LONGER STRAND THE GAME. If the replay failed part-way it used to leave the turn locked with End Turn hidden and no way to act; it now always reconciles. A second tap during the "units can still act" prompt could also end the turn twice, and no longer can. THE BATTLE BOARD REFITS WHEN YOU RESIZE. It was fitted once, when the battle opened, so maximising the desktop window left the board sized for the smaller one. Your zoom level survives the resize.
